import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.ExtensionUniformity

universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry Scheme

namespace Probe3
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

-- Q: is the bound in exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_curve monotone in b?
-- i.e. from `∃ b, ∀ D, b ≤ deg D → P D` can I get any larger b' works
example (P : ℤ → Prop) (b : ℤ) (h : ∀ d : ℤ, b ≤ d → P d) (b' : ℤ) (hb : b ≤ b') :
    ∀ d : ℤ, b' ≤ d → P d := fun d hd => h d (le_trans hb hd)

-- Q: what does the curve-level statement actually give -- can I extract an explicit bound
-- of the form deg D₀ + 1 - chi ?  Check chi_moduleKSheaf / GenusBridge shape at C_κ.
#check @AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_curve
#check @AlgebraicGeometry.chi_divisorSheaf_genus
#check @AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one

end Probe3
